amendment_reason: Storage/provenance-only amendment before any R3 or R4 radiometric change metric: preserve exact target-grid basin-window crops because full-scene R2 GeoTIFFs are multi-gigabyte. The crop window depends only on frozen basin geometry and frozen R2 grid; no signal value, outcome, threshold, support gate or pairing rule changed.
purpose: Pre-register common spatial support construction before any Cashahuacra Sentinel-1 pre/post difference or change metric is computed.

basin_window_preservation.rule: Derive the smallest integer target-grid window whose extent covers the frozen basin geometry, read the exact source pixels from each R2 GeoTIFF, and write them without resampling or radiometric transformation.

basin_pixelization.rule: Rasterize the frozen basin geometry on the frozen R2 target grid within the deterministic basin window using pixel-center semantics.
basin_pixelization.denominator: all target-grid pixel centers inside the frozen basin polygon

per_date_validity.rule: A basin pixel is valid for a date only when the raster dataset mask is valid, the Gamma0 value is finite, and the linear Gamma0 value is strictly greater than zero.

allowed_outputs: deterministic basin-window row/column offsets and dimensions
lossless pre and post basin-window GeoTIFFs and SHA-256
pre valid pixel count and fraction
post valid pixel count and fraction
common valid pixel count and fraction
binary common-support mask GeoTIFF and SHA-256
